name: Xalynne's Twins
source:
I used to know a woman named Xalynne, would you like to know her story? Xalynne is a short novel told in a unusual way, in a medieval setting with a pregnancy fetish. Characters and 3D graphics by Mark Volk.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/Xalynne.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
